name: Galaxy A10

images.credit: Marcusph, CC BY 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Predecessor: Samsung Galaxy J3 (2018), Samsung Galaxy J4

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 9.0 "Pie" with One UI 1.1 , Current: Android 11 with One UI 3.1
Platform.Chipset: A10 and A10e: Samsung Exynos 7 Octa 7884, A10s: Mediatek Helio P22
Platform.CPU: A10 and A10e: Octa-core (2x1.6 GHz Cortex-A73 & 6x1.35 GHz Cortex-A53), A10s: Octa-core (2.0 GHz Cortex-A53)
Platform.GPU: A10 and A10e: Mali-G71 MP2, A10s: PowerVR GE8320

Display.Display: A10 and A10s: 6.2" HD+ PLS TFT, A10e: 5.83" HD+ PLS TFT

Cameras.Rear camera: A10 and A10s: 13 MP, f/1.9 (f/1.8 for A10s), 28mm (wide), AF, A10e: 8 MP or 5 MP, f/1.9 AF, Features: LED flash, panorama, HDR, Video recording resolutions: 1080p@30fps

Battery.Battery: A10: 3400 mAh Li-Polymer Battery, A10e: 3000 mAh Li-Polymer Battery, A10s: 4000 mAh Li-Polymer Battery
